name: DC heartbeat overview
description: Selected-system baseline with latest heartbeat in the requested range. Older than 15 minutes is stale; missing telemetry remains unknown rather than healthy.
kql:
let Observed = Heartbeat
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by ComputerKey = tolower(Computer);
print Selected = _SelectedSystems
| mv-expand Computer = Selected to typeof(string)
| extend ComputerKey = tolower(Computer)
| join kind=leftouter Observed on ComputerKey
| extend AgeMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastHeartbeat)
| extend Status = case(isnull(LastHeartbeat), 'No telemetry', AgeMinutes > 15, 'Failed', 'Passed')
| project Computer, Status, LastHeartbeat, AgeMinutes
| order by Computer asc
